newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's TGS downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's TGS downgraded.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said it downgraded TGS, the biggest of Argentina's two gas transport firms, to market perform from buy saying it sees "slim returns in the pipeline."
-- Analyst Fernando Peres wrote in a report he expects an "unattractive" compound annual earnigns growth of only 5.0 percent over the 1997-2000 period.
-- "Given that the company is already highly efficient, there is limited room for further cost reduction."
-- "Furthermore, the entrance of (Argentina's) YPF and (Brazil's) Petrobras into the gas processing business after 2000 will hurt TGS's competitive position in the market."
-- "We are lowering our 12- to 18-month target price to $12.60 per ADR from $13.50...(and) our earnings per ADR estimates to $1.07 from $1.12 for 1997, and to $1.14 from $1.22 for 1998," Peres added.
